$schema: menu-selection page reads this. Add new weeks by appending to the menus[] array. The page picks the menu whose week_of date is the next upcoming Sunday from today; if none match, falls back to the most recent. The `upcharge_per_meal` field is read by calculate-specialty-upcharge.js — leave at 0 for standard meals, set to $1.00 (beef), $3.00 (steak), etc. for specialty proteins.
